title: Core Quartet #09
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Norwegian woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids and a braided crown, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, bold and confident, braided hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern — a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme cream platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Pakistani woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, cheerful, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic — a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense floral medallion border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme cobalt platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, long straight jet-black hair, a cold, poised expression, cool and composed, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin, cheerful, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer — a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands following every deep crease, dense zigzag linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme silver chrome platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
